# Kiyo Compass — Traceability

Snapshot: Prompt 06 (Governance), 2026-09-29. Requirement registration is not product
implementation. Read full criteria in [REQUIREMENTS.md](REQUIREMENTS.md).

Implementation statuses: NOT_IMPLEMENTED, PARTIALLY_IMPLEMENTED, IMPLEMENTED.
Verification statuses for checks: PASS, FAIL, NOT_RUN, NOT_APPLICABLE, BLOCKED.
All full requirement verifications are NOT_RUN. Prompt 02 documentation checks
validate research records, not native packages or behavior. Partial documentation
implementation is identified below; shared Core/Memory/governance are authored, while later
procedures, public skills, native packages and final-gap audit remain pending.
Prompt 03 architecture is design evidence only, not implemented product behavior.
Its document checks do not promote any full requirement verification or live result.
Prompt 04 adds partial product Markdown instruction coverage; static Core checks
are separate from unexecuted expected-response scenarios and live-host evidence.
Prompt 05 adds Memory specification/templates/procedures and NOT_RUN scenario
specifications. Static document checks are not behavioral or native-host results.
Prompt 06 adds governance policy text and NOT_RUN decision examples, not policy
engine/native permission enforcement or completed scenario evaluation.
Live target state uses NOT_TESTED until that target is actually tested.

Implementing Files lists actual implementation only. Proposed locations are in
the linked registry entries. TC-REQ-NNN means a **reserved planned identifier**;
no corresponding product test file or execution is claimed. An empty evidence
cell is shown as “—”, never as a passing result.

“All six” means the six targets individually listed in [BASELINE.md](BASELINE.md#target-baseline);
it is a scope label, not a compatibility assertion. Shared behavioral results do
not establish native host compatibility.
